snippet.title: Kunugi's Life Is a Mess! - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/kunugis-life-is-a-mess/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4429950/Kunugis_Life_is_a_Mess/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post

In this roguelike, turn-based dungeon-crawling RPG, play as Kunugi, a homeless girl driven by a pursuit of vengeance after her former bully ruined her life. Dive into dungeons, defeat your enemies, learn new skills, and gear up. Don’t let the bullies gain the upper hand over you!
